newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron rises 3.51 pct on technical bounce.
newsitem.headline: Petron rises 3.51 pct on technical bounce.

text.p: Petron Corp rose 20 centavos, or 3.51 percent, to 5.90 pesos in midtrade on Thursday on a technical rebound and improved confidence in the market after overnight rates were lowered by the central bank, brokers said.
"Maybe, it's an oversold issue," said David dela Cruz, vice-president for marketing at Amsteel Securities.
"It is slowly recovering. Maybe people see that depreciation and its effect on Petron need not be a cause for worry," said Cilette Liboro, research head at Orion-Squire Capital.
In midsession, a total of 2.93 million worth of Petron shares changed hands.
